authority_note: Requirements only, never permissions. The governing runbook, the gates document, and the per-course canon ledgers outrank this file. Live receipts win every current-state conflict.
sources: TimeBack course handbook DRAFT v0.3 (2026-08-26, Alpha workspace)
Codex re-review, out/handbook-replay-review-20260826 (8 findings; folded into v0.3)

generations.name: 12-gate canon with closure packets
generations.status: current; HumGeo first walking it end to end

row_mapping_precedence_rule: A trace row maps to the stage whose closing receipt it produces or repairs. A control, status, or approval row inherits the stage it affects. A row spanning stages splits by artifact. Stage 0 is A's entry predicate, so every row lands inside A-J.

hold_classes.name: known-check-skipped
hold_classes.rule: A KNOWN check was skipped, then failed after a later gate closed. Reopen the earliest affected gate for exactly the failing records.

hold_classes.name: upstream-bytes-moved
hold_classes.rule: Upstream bytes moved under a closure. Rebind on fresh digests.

hold_classes.name: approval-gap
hold_classes.rule: Approval gap. HOLD naming the owner and the exact authority artifact the course profile and phase plan require. Owner prose satisfies only an explicitly named approval predicate.

hold_classes.name: missing-factory-contract
hold_classes.rule: Missing factory contract. Classify, file through the filing gate, HOLD for the named approval predicate. Never adapt a runner locally.

hold_classes.name: identity-fault-at-acceptance
hold_classes.rule: Identity or learner-state fault at acceptance. Record the no-go, repair, retry.

hold_classes.name: uncorridored-timeback-write
hold_classes.rule: Any TimeBack write outside the named ap-one publisher (no plan digest, no zero-write replay) fails and earns no G-closure credit. Same-byte, same-contract creation-time artifacts stay reusable under the non-waste rule; the write itself never earns a gate.

hold_classes.name: leaked-answer-content
hold_classes.rule: Leaked answer text or keys on any committed or served artifact. Stop the line, purge, re-verify.

hold_classes.name: silent-pass-must-fail-closed
hold_classes.rule: Markup or format that must fail closed is passing silently. Make it fail closed, then repair what got through.

hold_classes.name: pilot-failed
hold_classes.rule: A pilot fails. Suspend and replan. Never retry blind.

hold_classes.name: landed-change-fails-own-suite
hold_classes.rule: A landed change fails its own suite. Same-day repair PR and reopen the affected receipt.

hold_classes.name: evidence-integrity
hold_classes.rule: A claim or receipt overstates its bytes. Reopen the stage whose receipt was overstated; it closes again only on a corrected, byte-bound receipt.

out_of_corridor_rule: A REMOTE Platform3 mutation during a native-corridor run maps to no stage and takes a HOLD. Local preparation, committed producer envelopes, and zero-write verification carry no HOLD and route by their actual stage function.

stages.name: Scaffold + source corpus
stages.entry_predicate: One writer proven (Gate 0 STABILIZED or an explicit NOT_REQUIRED) plus course assignment.
stages.pass_receipt: Gate 1 closure packet (SCOPE_LOCKED) for gen-3; repo evidence for gen-2 history.

proven.note: Packet plus gen-2 worked examples; entry predicate worked example is HumGeo's issue-44 stabilization cycle (trace rows 36-46).

stages.name: Compile machinery + inventory
required_artifacts: Full census of existing vs missing content with zero unknown rows
stages.reopen_target: Reopen Gate 2 for exactly the missed records.

stages.name: Content build
required_artifacts: Articles, items, video built through the factory
Every KNOWN bank-wide check run at generation (answer shape, balance, structure)
stages.reopen_target: Earliest affected gate for exactly the failing records.
stages.resume_evidence: Repaired records re-accepted through both factory QC layers.

proven.note: New checks invented later belong to D and do not retroactively convict C.

stages.name: QC waves + review lanes
stages.entry_predicate: Content exists (runs with and after C).
required_artifacts: Factory creation QC plus independent /v1/qc verdicts
Cross-model review; the agent that changes content never waives the gate that failed
stages.pass_receipt: Verdict receipts bound to exact bytes (Gate 3 + factory contracts).
stages.reopen_target: The stage whose receipt the failed verdict covers.
stages.resume_evidence: Fresh factory verdicts on the exact bytes.

proven.note: Lit's review lane caught placeholder rubrics; HumGeo re-earned 429 fingerprint-bound passes.

stages.name: Import + source/profile bind
stages.entry_predicate: Stage D-accepted source; reviewed course profile.
required_artifacts: Import receipt: named commit or PR + tree listing + layout under courses/<slug>/ (binds from the next course onward)
Bind to exact accepted-source digests with reviewed profile
stages.pass_receipt: Gate 4 packet (PROFILE_AND_SOURCE_BOUND) containing the import receipt.
stages.resume_evidence: New bind packet on current digests.
stages.contract_status: PARTIAL (codex finding 5): bind half proven, import half has no worked example anywhere

proven.note: Bind half has a packet (HumGeo). Import half is unreceipted in every course; the first receipted import defines it.

stages.name: Offline preview seal
required_artifacts: Phase 1 — map the complete course tree
Phase 3 — generate hosted assets and QTI; validate the student surface
stages.pass_receipt: OFFLINE_PREVIEW_SEALED packet (Gate 5; separate Phase 1, Phase 2, and Phase 3 evidence).
stages.resume_evidence: Sealed offline artifacts and deterministic rerun receipts.

proven.note: HumGeo has current evidence in Phase 1 and Phase 3; Phase 2 is DONE on its measured item-level scope, while resource-level base XP remains unmeasured platform metadata. No course has sealed this stage.

stages.name: Sealed plan + dark publish
stages.entry_predicate: OFFLINE_PREVIEW_SEALED; profile/source/tree/asset/QTI digests unchanged; conforming plan compiler exists.
required_artifacts: One immutable publication manifest and plan digest
Live all-absent checkpoint AS A FILE
Execute receipt under the global writer lock
Terminal zero-write replay AS A FILE
stages.pass_receipt: PUBLICATION_PLAN_SEALED (Gate 6) then DARK_PUBLISHED_REPLAYED (Gate 7) — closure requires the three files.
stages.reopen_target: Defect returns to its earliest affected phase.
stages.contract_status: PARTIAL (codex finding 5): checkpoint and replay never confirmed as files

proven.note: Lang chain and Lit #811 are worked examples; the all-absent checkpoint and zero-write replay were asserted in prose, not confirmed as files.

stages.name: Canary enrollment
stages.entry_predicate: DARK_PUBLISHED_REPLAYED; exact owner-approved slots; distinct identity/auth states proved.
required_artifacts: Separate enrollment plan, authority, and operator
stages.pass_receipt: CANARIES_ENROLLED_REPLAYED (Gate 8, runbook Phase 7). Never combined with activation.

proven.note: No complete forward worked example; the closest artifact is an enrollment repair.

stages.name: Private activation
stages.entry_predicate: CANARIES_ENROLLED_REPLAYED at 2/2; enrollment digest set unchanged.
required_artifacts: Production flags (publishStatus: published lives here, not stage J)
stages.resume_evidence: Activation packet with exact projection readback.

proven.note: Behind production flags; no gen-3 packet yet.

stages.name: Learner acceptance
stages.entry_predicate: PRIVATELY_ACTIVATED_REPLAYED; fresh untouched learners; served bytes equal the activated digest set.
required_artifacts: Start AND middle AND end paths
stages.pass_receipt: Full Gate 10 packet (LEARNER_ACCEPTED). A settlement sub-receipt or start-only run does not close it.
stages.reopen_target: Each defect returns to its earliest affected phase with a bounded Phase 10 plan.

proven.note: Lang: one no-go then a settlement sub-receipt. Lit: start-only. Neither closes the stage.

stages.name: Release
stages.entry_predicate: LEARNER_ACCEPTED; complete release checklist; zero open known issues; separate reviewed broader-enrollment all-absent plan; owner release decision.
stages.pass_receipt: RELEASED packet (Gate 11, runbook Phase 9.6 + release checklist).
stages.resume_evidence: First completed release becomes the fleet worked example.

proven.note: Nobody, anywhere. Canon rows P9-13, RLS-28, HO-16 are NOT_YET_MEASURED.
